meta.title: Mercs vs. Monsters passive sub-tree
meta.coordinates: PoE2 tree units. x = group.x + orbit_radii[r] * sin(2*pi*k/skills_per_orbit[r]); y = group.y - orbit_radii[r] * cos(...). y grows downward. Tree origin (0,0) is the centre ring.

method.excluded: ascendancy nodes, icon-only mastery art nodes, other class start nodes (impassable)
method.bridges: union of shortest start-to-start paths that contain at least one notable; plus notables within one detour step of a bridge midpoint
method.notable_score: greedy: fewest new nodes + 3 x unsupported fraction (keep 0, adapt 0.25, replace/drop 1), forced picks first

rules.attribute_node: Allocating an Attribute node asks for Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence; it grants +5 of that attribute to every hero. Default highlight = the focus attribute. Changing the choice later costs 0.5x the per-point respec price (PoE2 rule).
rules.point_budget: 1 per player level after 1, +2 for first kill of each boss (L5, L10, L15, L20)
